{{Quote|Now, if you will take me to the bridge, we will find Admiral Tarkin's ship.|Lady Saro to Darth Vader shortly before the battle|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a '''space battle''' took place in the [[Atoan system]] in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]] between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and [[Atoan]] defenders.

==Prelude==
During his search for missing [[Garoche Tarkin]] in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] interrogated the captured [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], an [[Atoan]] [[Shaman/Legends|sorceror]], as to the whereabouts of the admiral. Saro responded that, provided her demands were met, she would lead the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to the wreckage of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] formerly commanded by Tarkin.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Attack in groups of three. Use standard distract-and-flank maneuvers.|Vader to his squadron|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2" />}}
Encouraged by this, Vader launched from his own Destroyer in his [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|black interceptor]] along with an escort squadron of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wings]] and underlings [[Voca]] and [[Shale (human)|Shale]] to search the wreckage for clues.

However, the Imperial fighters could only discover signs of sabotage to the Destroyer before coming under attack from [[Atoan starfighter]]s. Despite several early kills by the Atoans, Vader soon organized his squadron, and the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Imperial pilots]] held their own, coming to understand that speed and agility were key factors - factors that the Atoan ships did not represent.

Following the turnabout, Vader ordered his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]] to break away, and harried the remaining lone Atoan [[Starship/Legends|ship]], forcing it to crash-land in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on the ruined Destroyer. Vader killed one of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], leaving the other alive for [[Torture/Legends|interrogation]].

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Fall back. I will take the last one alive.|Vader orders his ships to stand down|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2" />}}
The pilot revealed critical information before Vader [[Death/Legends|executed]] him; a tar-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] was to be the next target in the search for Garoche Tarkin; Vader decided upon a stealth attack, knowing also that his orders from [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were to kill Tarkin so as to engender anger and determination in [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Garoche's father]].
